_comfy_bridge.name: Depth - MoGe 2 (depth / normals)
_comfy_bridge.description: MoGe 2 (ComfyUI core nodes, local and Comfy Cloud, MIT licence). Best single-frame geometry: depth comes back 0-1, near = white (ready for the aux of Render to photo, ZDefocus math 'far = 0'), or a normal map. Set the plate's horizontal FOV if you know it; 0 = estimated.

params.label: output
params.tooltip: depth: 0-1, near = white. normal_opengl: green = up (Nuke Relight, Blender). mask: valid pixels (sky = black).

params.label: horizontal FOV
params.tooltip: Horizontal field of view of the plate camera in degrees (0 = let MoGe estimate it). 35 mm lens on full frame = 54.4.
